673d8bd62405.text: datasette-leaflet 0.3. Release: datasette-leaflet 0.3 OpenStreetMap have a very reasonable policy that hits to their hosted tile server should send a referrer header . Datasette table pages used the Referrer-Policy: no-referrer HTTP header, causing plugins that loaded tiles from OpenStreetMap to violate that policy. datasette-leaflet is the plugin that loads a bundled Leaflet so other Datasette plugins can depend on it. debates.title: Are we one year away from superintelligence?
debates.summary: Leading voices are rapidly shortening their timelines to superintelligence and debating whether urgent pauses are needed as AI advances into verifiable domains and recursive self-improvement. This shift highlights growing concerns that safety and security measures are falling behind actual capability gains.

debates.title: Is AI improving faster than we can measure?
debates.summary: Researchers are grappling with the reality that traditional metrics and systems are breaking down as AI capabilities saturate standard benchmarks and accelerate software vulnerability discoveries. This creates significant friction for developers and CIOs trying to keep pace with operational security demands.
